cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Start the Hard Part
cards.instruction: Get someone else to explain, announce, or begin the emotionally difficult part.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Could you phone Mum and begin the conversation about selling the house? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She asked to speak to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. I'll take over once you've said the word selling.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll put her on speaker. You'll be there for the whole thing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's fine. Introduce the idea, and when she says my full name, I'll answer.

mechanism: A manages a family call, accepting full presence and later answers while arranging for B to introduce selling before A speaks.
confusable: Unlike avoiding the whole call, A avoids its emotionally charged opening; borrowed authority yields call conditions to keep B beginning it.
comparison: Family reaction over speakerphone differs from facing a disappointed choir and refunds.
seedUse: Use D101-b Mum/house/selling/speaker with S02-a revised call terms; no hierarchy mechanism borrowed from the protected hamster pair.
